title: ChIPmentation
scope: Illumina explanatory ChIPmentation schematic, resolved to the bead-bound-chromatin implementation described by Schmidl et al. (PMID 26280331): antibody-mediated chromatin capture, Tn5 tagmentation while bead-bound, and the depicted combined DNA purification/amplification block yielding a DNA library. The far-left overview cartoon/caption names the method rather than supplying an extra upstream transformation. The three upstream ChIP protocols reported in the paper share this bead-bound interface at the level extracted here. Purified-DNA ChIP-tagmentation and ATAC-seq are distinct workflows discussed by the sources, with no separate route for either in this diagram. Sequencing is the supported use of the final DNA library, not a drawn operation.

states.label: Chromatin
features: DNA associated with chromatin proteins, drawn as two grey nucleosome-like stacks with short DNA strands.
The primary implementation enters tagmentation with already fragmented chromatin; the schematic does not depict the upstream fragmentation procedure.

states.label: Fragmented and primed (DNA within tagmented, bead-bound chromatin)
features: DNA is further fragmented and carries sequencing-compatible adapter sequences introduced during tagmentation.

The depicted blue DNA line has a pink segment at one end and a yellow-green segment at the other. The label primed indicates the adapter/priming state at schematic scope; explicit primer annealing is not shown.

operations.label: Chromatin immunoprecipitation
operations.description: Immunoprecipitate chromatin using an antibody-associated support, retaining protein-associated genomic DNA on beads. The drawing changes from unattached chromatin to a chromatin icon linked by a magenta Y-shaped antibody to the grey support; the primary implementation retains this bead-bound fraction for tagmentation.
operations.mechanism: Antibody-mediated enrichment of chromatin bearing the selected protein or histone modification; the card specifies a bead-bound product.
operations.information_effect: Select associated genomic DNA through the antibody target. This is enrichment whose interpretation depends on antibody quality and specificity; individual recovered fragments do not establish perfect target specificity.

operations.label: Adapter insertion
operations.description: Add Tn5 transposome to immunoprecipitated, bead-bound chromatin. Tagmentation further fragments the already fragmented chromatin DNA and introduces sequencing-compatible adapter sequences, summarized by the Fragmented and primed line. The supported substrate is captured chromatin, including its protein protection, rather than purified ChIP DNA.
operations.mechanism: Tn5-mediated tagmentation couples DNA fragmentation and adapter tagging in one reaction on bead-bound chromatin; the blue transposome is the reagent, not a specimen branch.
operations.information_effect: Introduce library priming handles into genomic DNA enriched by ChIP. Detailed insertion patterns can also reflect transposase sequence bias; the primary biological readout is genomic enrichment for the antibody target.

operations.label: DNA purification / Amplification
operations.description: The depicted combined DNA purification / Amplification block converts tagmented chromatin to recovered DNA and enriches the library by amplification. The paper specifies elution from beads, reverse-crosslinking and DNA purification after on-bead tagmentation, followed by library amplification; these are retained within the broad drawn block rather than expanded into an execution recipe.
operations.mechanism: Recovery releases genomic DNA from the captured chromatin, and PCR amplification produces additional copies of the adapter-bearing library.
operations.information_effect: Purified genomic DNA is the sequenced carrier. Mapping its inserts can establish the genomic distribution of enrichment associated with the immunoprecipitated chromatin protein or modification. Protein removal breaks the physical protein-DNA association while library composition retains the selection history; antibody specificity and Tn5 bias constrain the resulting interpretation. The schematic ends at DNA library production.

method_scopes.rationale: All three extracted operations apply to ChIPmentation as defined by the on-bead reaction. The far-left long caption expands the same method name; the title cartoon is not an additional material input. The paper reports three compatible upstream ChIP protocols, which converge on beads carrying immunoprecipitated chromatin; only their common interface is represented here. The differently named purified-DNA ChIP-tagmentation comparator is distinct, not an alias or a retained branch. The catalogue mentions combining ATAC-seq and ChIPmentation in an experiment, but neither the image nor that statement establishes material transfer between those assays. The pale chromatin icon at adapter insertion has no separately labelled route or final product; the primary source resolves the retained substrate as bead-bound chromatin.

corrections.diagram_observation: The diagram places a free-looking, protein-free blue DNA line with pink and yellow-green ends labelled Fragmented and primed before the DNA purification / Amplification block. It does not draw an intervening elution or protein-removal step.
corrections.primary_statement: The primary paper places tagmentation directly on bead-bound chromatin and only afterward resumes elution, reverse-crosslinking and DNA purification. Accordingly, the affected state is authored as adapter-tagged DNA still in bead-bound chromatin at the end of tagmentation; the free-line drawing is preserved as a schematic abstraction of DNA modification, and recovery remains in the downstream combined block.
